RESSOURCE_INTROUVABLE: The requested resource does not exist or is not accessible.
JETON_INVALIDE: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
AUCUN_PROFIL: No budget profile is assigned to your account. Contact the module administrator.
ACCES_REFUSE: You are not allowed to perform this operation.
MONTANT_INVALIDE: Invalid amount: at most two decimals.
CURSEUR_INVALIDE: Invalid pagination position; reload the list.
IDEMPOTENCE_CONFLIT: This operation was already sent with different data. Reload the form.
IDEMPOTENCE_EN_COURS: This operation is still being processed. Wait a few seconds.
PRECONDITION_REQUISE: Reload the record before editing it.
PRECONDITION_ECHOUEE: Someone else changed this record since you opened it. It has been reloaded: check it and try again.
LIMITE_DEBIT: Too many requests. Try again shortly.
HOPITALIA_INDISPONIBLE: The Hopitalia login service is not responding. Try again later.
AGENT_INTROUVABLE: No Hopitalia agent has this code. Check the agent code.
HABILITATION_EXISTANTE: This agent already has this profile for this facility.
AUTO_HABILITATION: You cannot change your own profiles; ask another administrator.
REFERENCE_INVALIDE: A field refers to a missing or incompatible item. Check your choices.
HIERARCHIE_INVALIDE: An item cannot be attached to one of its descendants.
DATES_INCOHERENTES: The end date must come after the start date.
EXERCICE_NON_OUVERT: This operation requires an open fiscal year.
BUDGET_PRIMITIF_EXISTANT: This facility already has an initial budget for this year.
CREDIT_INSUFFISANT: Insufficient credit on the debited line.
ETAPE_NON_AUTORISEE: This approval step belongs to another profile.
SEPARATION_DES_TACHES: You already entered or approved this operation: someone else must approve it.
MOTIF_OBLIGATOIRE: A rejection must state a reason.
CONFIGURATION_INCOMPLETE: The module is not configured for this operation yet. Contact the administrator.
NOTIFICATION_INCOHERENTE: The amounts per line must add up to the notified amount.
OPERATION_DEJA_TRAITEE: This operation is not awaiting any approval.
OPERATION_NON_MODIFIABLE: Only an operation returned for correction can be changed.
TRANSITION_NON_AUTORISEE: This action is not configured from the current status.
TRANSITION_INCOHERENTE: This transition matches no reference status transition.
CIRCUIT_INVALIDE: Steps numbered from 1, profiles allowed to approve, last step mandatory and given to the authorising officer.
PIECES_MANQUANTES: A mandatory document is missing: approval is not possible.
PIECE_ALTEREE: The file no longer matches its fingerprint: changed or lost.
PIECE_TROP_VOLUMINEUSE: A file must not exceed 20 MB.
TYPE_FICHIER_REFUSE: Accepted formats: PDF, PNG, JPEG, Word and Excel.
CONTRAT_NON_SIGNE: Give the signature or notification date: the module tracks contracts already signed.
VENTILATION_INCOHERENTE: The allocations must add up to the contract amount including tax.
CONTRAT_NON_VALIDE: An amendment applies only to an approved contract.
PLAFOND_INSUFFISANT: The new ceiling would be below zero or below the amount already committed.
ENGAGEMENT_INCOHERENT: The amount must equal the sum of the allocations, all positive.
CONTROLE_BLOQUANT: An automatic check found a gap: correct the commitment or request a derogation.
ANNULATION_IMPOSSIBLE: Only the remainder of an approved commitment can be cancelled; closing follows execution.
ENGAGEMENT_NON_VALIDE: An order always follows an approved commitment.
COMMANDE_SUPERIEURE_ENGAGEMENT: Orders would exceed the commitment's net amount.
QUANTITES_INCOHERENTES: Positive quantities, and accepted plus rejected at most equal to received.
RECEPTION_SUPERIEURE_COMMANDE: The cumulative accepted quantity would exceed the ordered one.
FACTURE_DOUBLON: Duplicate invoice: same supplier and number, or same date and amount. Give a release reason if it is really distinct.
FACTURE_NON_TRAITABLE: This action is not possible on the invoice in its current state.
DEDUCTION_INCALCULABLE: Give the amount or rate of the deduction: the contract does not provide it.
ECART_NON_EXPLIQUE: The reconciliation shows a gap: explain it to validate it.
LIQUIDATION_NON_ORDONNANCABLE: This settlement cannot be ordered for payment: its invoice is not fully settled, or it is already in an active payment order.
LIQUIDATION_NON_PAYABLE: This settlement is not in a payment order taken over by the accountant.
VENTILATION_PAIEMENT: Each share must be positive and their sum must equal the payment amount.
PAIEMENT_SUP_SOLDE: A share exceeds the amount left to pay on its settlement.
SEPARATION_PAIEMENT: You approved or ordered this settlement for payment: someone else must pay it.
CLOTURE_ENGAGEMENTS_EN_COURS: Some commitments of the year are still in their approval flow: approve or reject them before closing.
REPORT_LIGNE_ABSENTE: A line of a commitment to carry over does not exist in the next year's budget: create it before closing.
EXERCICE_NON_CLOS: This year is not closed for this facility.
